import HartshorneLib.Chapter4SimplePoleResidue

/-!
# Base-field values of simple-pole residues

At a closed point of a smooth curve over an algebraically closed field, the
structure map identifies the residue field with the base field. Transporting
the intrinsic simple-pole residue along this identification gives a base-field
linear residue, with kernel the regular differentials and value one on `dt/t`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry IsLocalRing

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- The inverse of the ground-field structure map on the residue field of a
closed point. This identification makes no choice of local parameter. -/
def curveResidueFieldEquivBase {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) :
    ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) ≃ₗ[k] k := by
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap k x) := by
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom)
    letI : Smooth (X.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
      SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth 1 _
    letI : Module k (X.left.residueField x) := X.left.residueFieldOverModule k x
    letI := Scheme.residueDeg_finite (K := k) hx
    letI : Algebra k (X.left.residueField x) :=
      (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap k x).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra.IsIntegral k (X.left.residueField x) :=
      Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite k _
    exact IsAlgClosed.algebraMap_bijective_of_isIntegral
  exact (LinearEquiv.ofBijective
    (Algebra.linearMap k (ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))) hbij).symm

@[simp]
theorem curveResidueFieldEquivBase_algebraMap {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (c : k) :
    curveResidueFieldEquivBase X hx
      (algebraMap k (ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) c) = c := by
  exact LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ c

@[simp]
theorem curveResidueFieldEquivBase_one {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) : curveResidueFieldEquivBase X hx 1 = 1 := by
  simpa only [map_one] using curveResidueFieldEquivBase_algebraMap X hx 1

/-- The intrinsic residue of a differential with at most a simple pole,
valued in the base field through the inverse of its structure map. -/
def curveSimplePoleResidueToBase {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) :
    curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x →ₗ[k] k :=
  (curveResidueFieldEquivBase X hx).toLinearMap.comp
    ((curveSimplePoleResidue X hx).restrictScalars k)

@[simp]
theorem curveSimplePoleResidueToBase_apply {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (ω : curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x) :
    curveSimplePoleResidueToBase X hx ω =
      curveResidueFieldEquivBase X hx (curveSimplePoleResidue X hx ω) := rfl

/-- A simple-pole differential has zero base-field residue exactly when it
is regular. -/
theorem curveSimplePoleResidueToBase_eq_zero_iff {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (ω : curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x) :
    curveSimplePoleResidueToBase X hx ω = 0 ↔
      (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  rw [curveSimplePoleResidueToBase_apply, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff,
    curveSimplePoleResidue_eq_zero_iff]

/-- Every base-field scalar occurs as the residue of a differential with at
most a simple pole. -/
theorem curveSimplePoleResidueToBase_surjective {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) :
    Function.Surjective (curveSimplePoleResidueToBase X hx) :=
  (curveResidueFieldEquivBase X hx).surjective.comp
    (curveSimplePoleResidue_surjective X hx)

/-- The base-field residue of `dt/t` equals one for every local parameter. -/
@[simp]
theorem curveSimplePoleResidueToBase_logDifferential {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    curveSimplePoleResidueToBase X hx (curveUniformizerLogDifferential X hx t ht) = 1 := by
  simp

/-- Base-field residue identifies simple principal parts of differentials
with the base field, independently of a local parameter. -/
def curveSimplePrincipalPartResidueEquivBase {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) :
    (curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x ⧸
      (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).comap (curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x).subtype)
      ≃ₗ[k] k :=
  ((curveSimplePrincipalPartResidueEquiv X hx).restrictScalars k).trans
    (curveResidueFieldEquivBase X hx)

@[simp]
theorem curveSimplePrincipalPartResidueEquivBase_mk {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (ω : curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x) :
    curveSimplePrincipalPartResidueEquivBase X hx (Submodule.Quotient.mk ω) =
      curveSimplePoleResidueToBase X hx ω := by
  simp [curveSimplePrincipalPartResidueEquivBase]

end
end Hartshorne
